title: AppGen generator-runtime jar cache is not auto-synced -- refresh it after generator changes
body:
`AppGen/generator-runtime/current` is the jar cache the AppGen builders read from. It is NOT refreshed automatically when you rebuild the generator. After changing generator Java, refresh it explicitly:

```powershell
AppGen/generator-runtime/prepare-npdev-generator-runtime.ps1 -RuntimeRoot D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\AppGen\generator-runtime
```

Pass `-RuntimeRoot` explicitly. This is a SEPARATE cache from the runtimehost-libs staging (see runtimehost-libs-dir-mismatch) -- a generator change needs this refresh; a kernel/adapter change needs the libs restage; a change touching both needs both. Rebuild-And-Restage.ps1 does all of them in order.
